sources.title: GitHub - sachinsharma9780/memweave: memweave is a zero-infrastructure ...
sources.snippet: Agent memory you can read, search, and git diff. memweave is a zero-infrastructure, async-first Python library that gives AI agents persistent, searchable memory — stored as plain Markdown files and indexed by SQLite. No external services. No black-box databases. Every memory is a file you can open, edit, grep, and version-control.

sources.title: GitHub - JianYingJia/MemWeave
sources.snippet: MemWeave is a long-term memory retrieval and selection pipeline for agents. The paper experiment code supports LongMemEval, LoCoMo, and PerLTQA, multiple OpenAI-compatible reader models, Letta-native baselines, and the Letta + xMemory memory-construction baseline.
